description: This file contains JavaScript functions for interacting with API endpoints related to organizations, such as listing organizations and fetching organization summaries. It includes API calls, data normalization, and export of functions for use in other parts of the frontend codebase.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches and returns a sorted list of organizations (tenants) for the current user, normalizing various data shape variants.

methods.name: getOrganizationSummary(tenantId)
methods.description: Retrieves a summary for a specified organization, including id, name, total cost, and user count, with optional navigation data fetch.
